subject: docs: clarify all remaining blocked tasks in MIGRATION_PROGRESS.md
body:
docs: clarify all remaining blocked tasks in MIGRATION_PROGRESS.md

- Remove stale duplicate Phase 2 template section (38 tasks already marked [x] above it)
- Convert all 8 remaining [ ] tasks to [!] with explicit block reasons and unblock conditions:
  - P1-1.1.1: mRemoteNG.Core split — large refactor, needs team review + CI green
  - P1-1.2.3: registry page refactor — depends on Core split (circular deps)
  - P1-1.5.2: DI wiring in Startup.cs — depends on Core split
  - P1-1.6.2/3: Ubuntu/macOS build verify — Windows-only source still in main project
  - P3-3.3.4: RDP parity — needs live RDP server
  - P3-3.7.2: RDP window embedding — XEmbed/NSView interop not wired yet
  - P4-4.1.3: UI automation — needs Avalonia.Headless.XUnit + booting app
  - P4-4.4.3: code signing — requires paid Apple Developer + Windows EV certs
- Fill Blocked Items Log table (was "No blocked items yet")
- Fix dashboard: Phase 1 4 blocked, Phase 4 2 blocked, total 92 done / 8 blocked

https://claude.ai/code/session_011wf1rnTGf2hrsHvAeV4PsL
